questions.query: Who was Naciketas and what did his father give away?

gold.edition: Max Müller, SBE 15 (1884) · Sacred Texts plain-text distribution
gold.quote: He had a son of the name of Nakiketas.

questions.query: What did Prajapati say to Indra when he came back after leaving with Virocana?

gold.edition: Max Müller, SBE 1 (1879) · Sacred Texts plain-text distribution
gold.quote: Pragapati said to him: 'Maghavat (Indra), as you went away with Virokana, satisfied in your heart, for what purpose did you come back?'

questions.query: Should Vaishvanara be meditated on in his aggregate form?

gold.edition: Thibaut, SBE 34 (scan of 1904 printing) and 38 (1896) · Sacred Texts HTML
gold.quote: There is pre-eminence of the (meditation on) plenitude (i.e. Agni Vaisvânara in his aggregate form), as in the case of sacrifices; for thus scripture shows.

questions.query: What happened when Shvetaketu went to the Panchalas and met Pravahana Jaivali?

gold.quote: Svetaketu Aruneya went to an assembly  of the Pankalas.
